title: A bare name completes to every type the server holds, a list opens only where a spelling ends, and the index covers the workspace by default
scope:
what `textDocument/completion` offers at a bare position, in markup and after a trigger
character, and the default of `nvs.check.scope`. Member lists after `->` and `::`, the namespace list
after `\` and the PHP-name layer are unchanged.
validatedBy:
`crates/nvs-lsp/tests/completion_edits.rs`, and the cases under
`tests/lsp/completion/` that cite the three rules this creates.
